@retractionwatch@social.trom.tf reports that some #authors are leaving prompts for #LLMs (large language models) in their #research papers to give positive reviews of their reports and to recommend  that #journals #publish them. And the prompts are camouflaged to make it hard for human #reviewers and #editors to spot them, so the prompts sometimes are still in place after publication. #fraud #AI 
https://retractionwatch.com/2026/11/19/prompt-injection-ai-llm-peer-review-published-papers/
